basis: This run primary publisher notice HTML for four DOI records; partial indexed publisher extract for fifth; source-backed original pages linked. Original historical PDFs not independently replayed.
ownership_note: Provisional bare-lowercase-DOI SHA256 modulo 10, consistent with earlier shards 0,2,5; the coordinator must resolve doi:-prefix discrepancy before global totals.

records.original_type: observational/translational laboratory study using explanted lung tissue; not an RCT
records.historical: Publisher states original figures lacked significance levels
records.replacement: Notice republishes Figures 1-7 with significance annotations; Figure 1 caption specifies *P<0.05, ***P<0.001 and n=12 per cohort; Figure 3 caption separately states n=6 control and n=4 NR-COVID-19 for a protein assay
records.notice_locator: Correction body, immediately after 'Correction to:', and Figures 1-7 captions
records.current_version_evidence: Original article Change history states online version revised 25 May 2025 (funding and figure significance) and notice published 26 May; individual corrected pixels not inspected
records.strongest_benign: Addition of visual significance annotations may not require recomputation of P values or imply changed underlying measurements. Figures differ in assay-specific sample sizes; using n=12 for every figure is invalid.
records.estimator_signature: NOT_COMPARABLE for reproducing P values without individual figure/model/variance/test and precision; legend-only semantic check is permitted
records.computation: No P-value recalculation or unverified cross-figure denominator arithmetic

test_proposal.historical: Missing significance glyphs on known comparison panels
test_proposal.corrected: Same panels with verified intended * and *** glyphs
test_proposal.benign: Genuinely nonsignificant panel intentionally lacks stars; figure-specific sample sizes differ
test_proposal.abstain: Figure image or statistical comparison assignment unavailable => HOLD

records.publisher: Springer Nature / Journal of Hematology & Oncology
records.original_type: single-arm phase I/II cancer vaccination clinical report, published under Correspondence; not randomized
records.historical: Current original article HTML still shows malformed author strings for items 2 ('Van de Anguille S...') and 9 ('n der Burg SH...')
records.replacement: Publisher notice specifies reference 2 should begin Anguille S, Van de Velde AL, Smits EL... and reference 9 should begin van der Burg SH
records.notice_locator: Correction body: text introducing references 2 and 9, followed by two bullets
records.current_version_evidence: Original publisher article References entries 2 and 9 retrieved as malformed despite article banner linking correction; alternate latest PDF/current content not authenticated
records.strongest_benign: The public HTML may be stale/cached or source metadata not synchronised with a corrected PDF. Bibliographic corruption does not imply altered patient outcomes or misconduct.
records.computation: No numerical data reanalysis; note 39 evaluable patients in original refers to clinical study, not a randomized comparison

test_proposal.historical: Incorrect cited-author tokens at exact reference numbers
test_proposal.benign: Legitimate van/Van or initials styling variation without wrong source identity
test_proposal.abstain: Publisher current Version of Record PDF not verified => HOLD

records.original_type: secondary observational analysis of multicenter RCT (NCT01320384); not a new randomized treatment result
records.claim_locator: Original Tables 1 and 2 PaO2/FiO2 median (IQR) rows; Table 3 p and adjusted effect cell placement
records.historical: Table 1 no-dyspnea median 129 (98–171), mild 135 (103–182), moderate 154 (92–197), severe 133 (105–165); Table 2 all-patients median 146 (97–199)
records.replacement: Notice: Table 1 no-dyspnea 135 (103–182), mild 154 (92–197), moderate 133 (105–165), severe 115 (96–156); Table 2 all 133 (103–173); two P values and one odds-ratio label/value misplaced in Table 3
records.notice_locator: Correction text after 'Correction to' paragraphs and explicitly labelled Incorrect/Correct Tables 1,2,3
records.current_version_evidence: Original article has 26 Feb 2025 Change history linking correction; publisher notice HTML displays both incorrect/correct table links but embedded cells unavailable via web table endpoint
records.strongest_benign: Copy-paste and wrong row/group placement may change displayed medians without changes to original statistical computations. Baseline table and one-hour table have different populations/timepoints (259 vs 253), not interchangeable. Publisher says P values unchanged (0.231, 0.296), not independently replayed.
records.estimator_signature: NOT_COMPARABLE for subdistribution hazard ratios and inferential P until population/time window/model/adjustment/missingness/censoring/variance method/test identity verified
records.computation: No averaging of subgroup medians or calculation of Cox/subdistribution HR from counts. Source-attested textual before/after comparison only.

test_proposal.historical: Copied medians into incorrect dyspnea group rows and P/OR moved across table rows
test_proposal.benign: Different 0h vs 1h cohorts and adjusted vs unadjusted models; do not numerical-compare them
test_proposal.abstain: Exact current cells / 12-field signature unavailable => HOLD

records.publisher: Springer Nature / Intensive Care Medicine Experimental
records.original_type: machine-learning prognostic modelling using participants from EPaNIC RCT NCT00512122, not a new randomization
records.claim_locator: Original article Abstract > Methods > ICU-acquired weakness MRC threshold; Methods > Outcome
records.historical: Publisher correction says abstract threshold incorrectly read MRC higher than 48
records.notice_locator: Correction text after original-article DOI, two sentences before reference
records.current_version_evidence: Current publisher original Abstract Methods and Methods outcome both say MRC lower than 48; original links 20 Oct 2025 correction
records.severity: S2_TEXT_CORRECTION; POTENTIALLY S4 IF UNRECOGNISED BUT RESOLVED
records.strongest_benign: Published correction identifies an abstract typo, while Methods already describes the lower-than-48 rule; this does not prove the trained model labels or AUC were inverted. Parent RCT N=4,640 differs from modelling subset N=600.
records.estimator_signature: NOT_APPLICABLE to categorical MRC sign correction; performance estimate replication requires complete 12-field model specification
records.computation: Original current Results display 232/600 as 38.6%; exact fraction 38.6666667%. Ordinary rounding to one decimal is 38.7%; truncation produces 38.6%. Separate UNADJUDICATED_HOLD presentation check pending published rounding convention and population/variable confirmation, not counted as correction-notice issue.

test_proposal.benign: Different scale or endpoint may legitimately use the opposite direction, if source-verified
test_proposal.abstain: Codebook, original Methods or endpoint wording missing => HOLD

records.original_type: preclinical atherosclerosis nanoparticle and cell/animal study, not human randomized trial
records.historical: Indexed publisher notice extract says control representative image was from Evol 1.25 nM treatment group; Fig 2B TEM scale mislabelled 200 µm
records.replacement: Publisher notice extract describes replacement control image and corrected scale 200 nm
records.notice_locator: Publisher-indexed text under Correction to DOI and Incorrect/Correct Figure 1/2 headings; full publisher HTML/PDF could not be opened independently
records.current_version_evidence: Original publisher article opened and linked to issue; correction publisher full text blocked at web.open, so no full-review credit
records.strongest_benign: Correcting an illustrative control image or scale bar need not change quantification. The publisher claims no result change, which is not independently validated.
records.estimator_signature: NOT_APPLICABLE for text label; imaging quantification NOT_COMPARABLE without raw images and relevant measures
records.computation: 200 μm = 200,000 nm, vs corrected 200 nm, so the mislabeled printed scale represents factor 1,000; this is not a measured size change.

test_proposal.historical: Figure control image assigned from a treated group and TEM unit µm
test_proposal.benign: Legitimate group-specific representative images and different microscopy magnifications
test_proposal.abstain: No full notice/historical figure image => HOLD
